meanings.note: Used as a noun or adverbially to mean 'for life / forever'.

examples.trans: I will never forget it for the rest of my life.

examples.text: これは一生の思い出です。
元国鉄マンの旦那を忘れずにさみしくて泣いてる
examples.trans: You're crying for your husband, a former National Rail worker.

examples.text: ちょっとやめてはい下りて
夕ごはんできてますよ早く下りてきなさい
